title: Area 51 was only Groom Lake; Dreamland was Areas 53 and 54
summary: Charles Hall tells of Area 51 was only Groom Lake; Dreamland was Areas 53 and 54, about 1965 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Nevada test ranges (Groom Lake, Indian Springs Valley, Dog Bone Valley, French Peak)

tellings.quote: Area 51 was not actually Dreamland itself. It was merely Groom Lake. Dreamland was area 53 and 54,

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who told podcast host Jesse Michels he spent three years with tall white aliens at Nevada's secret test ranges, says that around 1965 the layout was different from what people assume. According to Hall, Area 51, the famous secret military base, was only the site at Groom Lake, a dry lakebed, while the real 'Dreamland,' the nickname for the most secret zone, was Areas 53 and 54. If true, it would mean the most hidden activity happened somewhere other than the well-known base.
